Coram : BHUSHAN RAMKRISHNA GAVAI*, K.V. VISWANATHAN
Issue for Consideration Under what circumstances could the power be invoked for further investigation and whether on the facts, further investigation was warranted. Headnotes† Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 – s. 178(3) – Further investigation – Applications filed by the investigation or re-investigation by examining the related occurrence and eyewitnesses of the crime mentioned in the application and submit additional/supplementary charge-sheet – Dismissed by the trial court holding that further investigation cannot be ordered at the post cognizance stage
Decision Date : 30-09-2024 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 4058/2024 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
